text.card: A red giant 2,113 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.90 solar masses and 7.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,586 K at its surface.
